description: Use when someone asks what applies to a rented home at a postcode in England. Returns whether a council property licence is needed for the household type, the council's licensing schemes, the planned landlord register window, flood zone and conservation area, each with its source. Read-only. England only; a council we have not researched yet says so instead of guessing. Information, not legal advice.

household.description: single: one household; small_hmo: 3-4 people from 2+ households; large_hmo: 5+ people from 2+ households

postcode.description: Full postcode of the rented property, not the user's own location, e.g. SE15 5BA

name: check_address
title: Rules for a rental address
